# Folder paths can differ from display names

At revision a5701b14a54abf2d51b510b1e4e7c3af77bf93ab, the accounts MV3 test expects the folder name Ϟ to have a local path segment b52bc214 on Windows and Ϟ elsewhere. It expects the IMAP path segment &A94- for the same name. Use returned folder paths and IDs rather than assuming a display name is the stored path segment. These are test expectations for these fixtures, not proof of every character conversion. The supplied evidence does not show a test run.

Scope: WebExtension folder paths.
